title: Crispy Vegetable Spring Rolls with Sweet Chilli Dip
summary: A quick stir-fry of cabbage, carrot, shiitake and bean sprouts is drained and cooled, rolled tightly in spring roll pastry and deep-fried at 175 °C, then served with a sweet chilli dip.

ingredients.item: red bird's eye chillies, deseeded and finely chopped
fine sea salt or table salt
spring onions, cut into 3 cm lengths
spring roll pastry sheets (about 20 cm square), thawed
plain flour mixed with 3 tbsp water, to seal

steps.title: Make the dip
steps.text: Stir the sugar, vinegar, ketchup, chillies and salt until dissolved.

steps.title: Stir-fry
steps.text: Stir-fry the garlic, ginger and mushrooms, then the cabbage, carrot, sprouts and spring onions; add the seasoning.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Drain and spread the filling out until completely cold.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Roll 2 tbsp filling tightly in each pastry sheet, folding in the sides, and seal with flour paste.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Fry at 175 °C for 4-5 minutes until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drain and serve hot with the dip.

tips: A dry, cold filling is the secret to crisp rolls that do not burst.
Keep unused pastry under a damp towel so it does not crack.
Freeze uncooked rolls on a tray, then fry from frozen for 6-7 minutes.
safety: Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
storage: Best eaten hot. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours for up to 2 days and re-crisp in a 200 °C oven for 8-10 minutes until piping hot.
